As the Indian festive season—spanning Pujo, Navratri, and Diwali—approaches, shoppers are already planning their wardrobes, seeking ethnic wear, accessories, and beauty products. The Big Fashion Festival caters to this seasonal demand by offering early access deals, encouraging customers to start their festive preparations with special promotions and discounts. The event is designed to capitalize on the increase in consumer spending during the festive period by providing attractive options for festive attire and gifts.

The article also provides a detailed buyer’s guide emphasizing key features like material, fit, durability, and price. Each recommended set has been tested through various activities, including cardio, Pilates, and strength training, ensuring realistic insights into their performance. The guide reflects the New York Post’s commitment to honest, hands-on product evaluation and consumer transparency.
